title: Keep your Apple keyboards crumb-free with this Wolfbox electric air duster deal ($20 off)
content:
Macworld

Wolfbox MF70

View Deal

As slim as Apple’s Magic Keyboards are, dust, dirt, and crumbs still can get under the keys, whether we’re talking about dust or your lunch crumbs. Well, in such situations, one of these electric air dusters like the Wolfbox MF70 will be so useful. Now available for just $40 at Amazon, you can clean your keys for $20 less than you’d usually pay.

This air duster comes with a motor that spins up to 111,000 RPM, sending a focused stream of air into all those nooks and crannies, clearing dust and crumbs without touching delicate parts. Of course, if the job requires a more delicate approach, you can change the speed to 25,000 RPM for sensitive electronics and 60,000 RPM for routine dusting. That gentle low setting is perfect to use for all your Apple products, whether you’re tackling your keyboard or your iPhone speaker.

Another amazing thing about this Wolfbox MF70 is that it’s cordless and rechargeable, so you can move freely around your desk. On the lowest speed, a full charge lasts up to 300 minutes, which is months of cleaning. And when you need to fill it up, you can use a regular USB-C cable to recharge it. You’ll also get several attachments for smaller spaces.

So stop buying cans of compressed air and grab the Wolfbox MF70 for $40 before the deal runs out.
